notes.title: 【News】ABYA:Paint Ball confirmed for Bilibiliworld2024！
notes.content:
Pixel-inspired cyberpunk platformer shooter puzzle game ABYA:Paint Ball confirmed for Bilibiliworld2024!
Exhibition Time: July 12 (Fri) ~ July 14 (Sun), 2024
Venue Address: National Exhibition and Convention Center（Shanghai）
Booth Location: Hall 2.1H Indie Game Zone 2G2-03 Pone Games Booth

Exhibit Information
- Experience the latest demo version of ABYA:Paint Ball!
- Limited badges, PP clips and other goodies will be distributed!
- Limited badges, PP clips and other goodies will be given out!
For more information about the game, please check out the official news, and stay tuned!
